title: Nevmind Propaganda
description: Propaganda for the legendary YouTuber Nevmind
body:
# 📦 NevMind Totem Resourcepack

**This resourcepack replaces the default Totem of Undying in Minecraft with a NevMind-themed totem!
Perfect for fans of the YouTuber NevMind, so you can carry a piece of his style with you on every adventure.**

![nevmind](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbce47ddfa4dba4da572c80bb876d4b78faa7106_0.webp)

## ✨ Features
_Unique NevMind totem texture.
Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.21. It also changes the splash texts too every staff member!!
Lightweight and easy to install._


## ⚡ Installation
_Download the .zip file from this page.
Place it in your resourcepacks folder.
Enable the resourcepack in Minecraft.
Enjoy your brand-new NevMind Totem!_
